# 2 Baruch Chapter 84 — Disagreement Log
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Source:** Syriac MS (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1) | **Section:** Baruch's Letters
**Date:** 2026-03-17

---

## 84:4 — after tribulation, consolation

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | "after-the-time-of-the-tribulation-will-come-consolation" |
| LOGOS | "after the time of the tribulation will come consolation" |
| PNEUMA | "after the time of suffering will come comfort" |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** SOPHIA adopted LOGOS. 'Tribulation' and 'consolation' are the standard paired eschatological terms; PNEUMA's 'suffering' and 'comfort' are vaguer and lose the technical sense of the Hebrew/Syriac pair.

---

## 84:6 — covenant renewability

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | "the-covenant which-was-made with-your-fathers was-not-made for-ever" |
| LOGOS | "the covenant which was made with your fathers was not made forever" |
| PNEUMA | "the covenant made with your ancestors was not meant to last only for a time" |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** SOPHIA adopted LOGOS. PNEUMA inverts the meaning: the Syriac says the covenant was NOT forever (implying it must be renewed); PNEUMA's paraphrase suggests it was meant to be temporary, which reverses the theological point.

---
